details: Bitcoin experienced a $175 million net inflow into spot ETFs on September 4, marking the third consecutive day of positive inflows, with BlackRock's IBIT leading. Despite this, Bitcoin's price slipped below $80,000, and even below $79,000, as unexpectedly strong U.S. employment data revived fears of potential Federal Reserve rate hikes, impacting crypto valuations. BTC had earlier been tracking toward a third straight weekly gain, touching highs above $82,000.
title: Bitcoin Sees ETF Inflows but Faces Pressure from Fed Rate Hike Fears

details: British investment firm Hargreaves Lansdown, which manages nearly £173 billion in assets, has reversed its previous stance and is now offering Bitcoin and other cryptocurrency exchange-traded notes (ETNs) to its clients. This move comes after the firm had previously warned customers about the volatility of Bitcoin.
title: UK's Largest Investment Platform, Hargreaves Lansdown, Rolls Out Bitcoin Trading

details: Ethereum has continued its recent surge, jumping over 5% in the last 24 hours to trade above $2,500, bringing its monthly gain to more than 35%. Spot Ethereum ETFs have accumulated over $1 billion in net inflows over the past nine trading days. Additionally, Ethereum whale selling has sharply slowed, reaching its lowest level in five weeks, potentially easing near-term selling pressure.
title: Ethereum Maintains Strong Gains Amid Continued ETF Inflows

details: Japanese energy and technology company Remixpoint has announced a shift to a Bitcoin-only strategy. The firm sold all its holdings of Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), XRP, and Dogecoin (DOGE) on September 1, 2026, generating approximately $5.6 million in proceeds, to focus solely on its Bitcoin treasury holdings.
title: Japanese Firm Remixpoint Shifts to Bitcoin-Only Strategy

details: Zcash (ZEC) is trading above $1,000, building on a 16% gain from the previous day and hitting a nine-year high. On-chain data indicates a steady increase in shielded supply to 4.86 million ZEC tokens, suggesting growing demand for the privacy-focused cryptocurrency.
title: Zcash Price Surges to Nine-Year High Driven by Privacy Demand
